note: No mayoral election in this year. The Jackson County (Kansas City) Election Board index lists three elections in 2010: April 6 (School Directors), August 3 (Primary) and November 2 (City of Kansas City General Election). The August 3 and April 6 summary reports and the November 2 statement of votes cast (660 pages, Kansas City, Missouri) were opened as archived copies and contain no mayor contest; the November 2 report lists federal, state and constitutional amendment contests. The same index lists a municipal primary and general election only in 2011, 2015, 2019 and 2023 (descriptions: City of Kansas City Primary/General Election, Municipal Primary, Municipal General), which shows a four-year mayoral cycle. Scope note: the reports are the Jackson County portion of Kansas City; the mayoral contest appears on the Kansas City ballot in all three counties in the same election, as the verified 2011, 2015, 2019 and 2023 entries show.

Kansas City holds a nonpartisan mayoral primary and then a general election; the general election decided the office. The county election authority results for the decisive round are recorded in kansas_city_results.json.
